creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-28, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, template mannequin, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 11) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames stored at 40 px, centred on the 32 px manifest canvas, no scaling). v3 needs >=4 frames, so the 3-frame idle and telegraph clips use frame_select of 4 generated frames. Four facings are separate generations; nothing mirrored.
prompt: Slate carrier, a small chibi stone-quarry porter: a stocky hunched worker with a big head in a rough grey cloth wrap, carrying a huge flat slab of dark slate stone strapped on its back with bronze straps, the slab taller than its head with a glowing cyan crack across it, thick short legs, bronze-banded wrists, small dark eyes under a stone brow. Clear silhouette dominated by the slate slab. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.
